# Mitipi / KEVIN® 3

> KEVIN® 3 is a Swiss presence simulator (burglary deterrent) by Mitipi AG, Fribourg. It makes an empty home look and sound occupied with light, patented moving shadows and 70+ hours of household sounds from 32 GB inside the device. No camera, no microphone, keeps running when Wi-Fi is jammed. €579.95 one-time, no subscription.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-17. Full summary (read for complete context): https://mitipi.eu/cdn/shop/t/1/assets/llms-full.txt.

## Key facts

- Product: KEVIN® 3 (Kevin 3, KEVIN 3.0), third generation, sold since 2023.
- Category: presence simulator, burglary deterrent, privacy-first home security.
- Price: €579.95 one-time; optional colour front covers €29.95 each. No subscription.
- Included: device with Grey cover, adapter, Kevin app (iOS/Android), 70+ hours of scenes, lifetime updates, 3-year Swiss warranty, 30-day returns, free shipping.
- Privacy: no camera, no microphone, nothing streamed or shared; scenes stored on the device.
- Jammer resilient: keeps playing when Wi-Fi is jammed. About 9 W, 3 m cable, 21.2 × 10.2 × 9.2 cm.
- Setup: place by a window, pair the app, set a weekly schedule or geofencing.
- Ships to: all 27 EU countries, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Iceland (free shipping); prices in local currency at checkout (EUR, CHF, CZK and others).
